children: New Delhi, Oct. 8 -- The Tata Group company declared its second-quarter numbers for the current financial year 2026-27. In the Q2 results today, TCS met the market estimates by reporting a net profit of Rs.73,188 crore, and an annualised AI-led revenue of $3.1 billion. The annualised AI-led revenue exceeded 10% of the company's net revenue. The key attraction of today's TCS Q2 results is the announcement of a Rs.12-per-share dividend.
Here we list out the top 10 key highlights of the TCS Q2 results 2026:

1] Revenue growth: The Q2 revenue of the company during the September 2026 quarter stood at Rs.73,188 crore, up 11.20% YoY in terms of Indian Rupee and 1.3% QoQ. The company's international revenue grew 1.2% QoQ in constant currency terms. Annualised AI revenue stood at $ 3.1 billion in Q2FY27, crossing 10% of revenue.
